pillars.title: A Hospital Beside the Sunnybrook Ravine
pillars.body: Comfortable lodgings, an on-site gym, delicious meals crafted by enthusiastic chefs, and ample green space for relaxation can be found at Bellwood. Nestled within the serene Sunnybrook Park, this green haven is just minutes from downtown Toronto. Bellwood, founded by renowned addiction expert Dr. Gordon Bell, is a fully accredited facility that has been serving the community for over three decades.

pillars.title: A Year of Aftercare and an Alumni Network
pillars.body: Eligible patients who finish an inpatient program at EHN Bellwood Toronto get a year of aftercare. In practice that means a weekly group with other alumni, where people go over the skills they learned, talk through what has been hard since discharge and keep their relapse prevention plan honest. Patients in the hybrid program do their follow-up online, which helps if home is in Durham, Peel or farther out. Everyone also gets lifelong membership in the EHN Canada Alumni Association, and some alumni come back to run the Thrive Café on site.

pillars.title: The Clinical Team at Bellwood
pillars.body: A devoted and highly skilled team of doctors, nurses, social workers, psychotherapists, occupational therapists, and other specialists staff Bellwood. Their cutting-edge programs tackle alcohol and drug addiction, depression and anxiety, PTSD, personal trauma, eating disorders, and behavioral addictions like gambling. Services encompass on-site medical detox, inpatient care, a wellness center with optional massage, chiropractic, and acupuncture treatments, intensive outpatient programs (IOP) through EHN Online, a family program for healing loved ones, and 12 months of aftercare services.

overview: Specialized services are offered at Bellwood for healthcare providers, individuals recovering from concussions requiring additional support during treatment, and those with eating disorders, supervised by expert psychiatrists and registered dietitians. The facility also houses an inpatient OCD program operated by Sunnybrook Hospital. The Trauma Recovery Program is an inpatient initiative designed for individuals who have experienced personal or workplace trauma.
serviceCaption: 11 services · massage, chiropractic and acupuncture cost extra
afterOverview: All programs employ a holistic treatment strategy, incorporating the most recent evidence-based treatment methods in both group and individual contexts. Treatments can involve individual counseling, motivational interviewing (MI), prolonged exposure therapy (PET), cognitive processing therapy (CPT), virtual reality, and peer support groups like 12-Step meetings and SMART recovery. Program participants have the chance to develop skills in mindfulness, emotion regulation, communication, conflict resolution, and life skills, all crucial for lasting recovery.

location.heading: EHN Bellwood Toronto in Toronto, Ontario
location.intro: EHN Bellwood Toronto is at 175 Brentcliffe Road in East York, near Leaside, with the Sunnybrook ravine lands right behind it. Downtown Toronto is about 20 minutes away by car, Markham and Mississauga are roughly 30 to 40 minutes, and Hamilton or Barrie take a little over an hour, so family from most of the GTA can visit without much trouble.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and the EHN Canada website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How long is treatment at EHN Bellwood Toronto?
faqs.a: Most inpatient programs run about 7 weeks. The drug and alcohol program starts at 7 weeks and can run longer, the Trauma, PTSD and Psychological Injury program is 7 weeks, and the OCD program is 12 weeks. The centre says stays range from a 4-day detox to a 64-day program or more, depending on the person.

faqs.q: Is treatment covered by OHIP or private insurance?
faqs.a: Some beds at EHN Bellwood Toronto are OHIP-funded for eligible Ontario residents, and the OCD program can be OHIP-funded with a physician referral. Private insurance covers treatment for many people, sometimes only in part. The centre does not publish prices; admissions gives a quote after a free assessment, so call to check what your plan will pay.

faqs.q: Does EHN Bellwood Toronto offer medical detox?
faqs.a: Yes. Detox is medically supervised on site, with dedicated detox beds and an on-site pharmacy. Nurses and counsellors are there around the clock, doctors and psychiatrists work on site, and Sunnybrook Hospital is next door if an emergency comes up.

faqs.q: Where is the centre and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The centre is at 175 Brentcliffe Road in East York, Toronto, near Leaside and the Sunnybrook ravine. It's about 20 minutes by car from downtown Toronto and roughly 30 to 40 minutes from Markham or Mississauga. Call admissions before you come so they can confirm your arrival time.

Eligible patients get one year of aftercare, built around a weekly group with other alumni. You also get lifelong membership in the EHN Canada Alumni Association. People in the hybrid program continue online for eight weeks after a two-week stay before moving into aftercare.

faqs.q: Is there a program for trauma and PTSD?
faqs.a: Yes. The Trauma, PTSD and Psychological Injury inpatient program runs for 7 weeks in small cohorts and uses Cognitive Processing Therapy and Prolonged Exposure, along with CBT and DBT skills. There's also a separate inpatient program for people dealing with trauma and addiction together.

faqs.q: Do I need a referral to get in?
faqs.a: No. You can call or fill in the online form yourself, and an admissions coordinator will talk through your needs and check which program fits. The one exception is OHIP funding for the OCD program, which needs a physician referral.

faqs.q: What types of programs and services does Bellwood Health Services offer?
faqs.a: Bellwood Health Services offers a variety of programs and services, including on-site medical detox, inpatient treatment, intensive outpatient programs, a wellness center, a family program, and 12 months of aftercare services. They address issues such as alcohol and drug addiction, depression and anxiety, PTSD, personal trauma, eating disorders, and behavioral addictions.

faqs.q: What is the treatment approach at Bellwood Health Services?
faqs.a: Bellwood utilizes a holistic approach to treatment, focusing on the individual’s unique needs and addressing both addiction and any underlying or associated mental health issues. They combine evidence-based treatment modalities in both group and individual settings.

faqs.q: Who is part of the Bellwood Health Services team?
faqs.a: The Bellwood team consists of dedicated and highly skilled professionals, including doctors, nurses, social workers, psychotherapists, occupational therapists, and other specialists.

faqs.q: What are the accommodations like at Bellwood Health Services?
faqs.a: Bellwood offers comfortable accommodations, an on-site gym, delicious meals prepared by passionate chefs, and ample green space for relaxation. The facility is located within the serene Sunnybrook Park, just minutes from downtown Toronto.

faqs.q: Does Bellwood Health Services provide specialized services?
faqs.a: Yes, Bellwood provides specialized services for healthcare providers, individuals recovering from concussions, and those with eating disorders. They also host an inpatient OCD program operated by Sunnybrook Hospital and offer an inpatient Trauma Recovery Program.

faqs.q: Whats the cost of treatment at Bellwood Health Services
faqs.a: The cost of treatment at Bellwood Health Services can vary depending on the specific program, duration, and individual needs of the client. To obtain accurate and up-to-date pricing information, it is best to contact Bellwood Health Services directly. You can reach out to them through their website or by phone to discuss your needs, insurance coverage, and payment options. Keep in mind that some insurance plans may cover a portion of the treatment costs, and financing options might be available as well.
